sources.text: Very friendly staffs and the store vibe feels very cool for tourist like me! I had so much fun looking at photos on the wall, it was like seeing history! Pizza did not disappoint! I normally prefer simple cheese pizza but here, pepperoni was superior! The hint of spice in the pepperoni paired so well with the simple base. Definitely worth the visit if u like pizza. Loved this place! The service was great! That coal fired oven and years of experience add up to some incredible pizza! Loved the whole place. We got the john's original on half and added kalamata olives to the other side. There was a line to get in, but it moved quickly and was worth the short wait! After 30 minutes shivering outside in the cold, I got seated in. Ordered the Johns Original. The pizza was ok. Not the best I have had but I would love to try the Sasso next time or maybe a pizza with some toppings. They refused to reheat the pizza even though I told them it was ok to microwave the remaining slices if they don't want to put them back in oven but I had no option but to eat it like that. Atmosphere was awesome and it was super crowded. Didn't have to wait inside much for my order. Overall experience was ok. Really good garlic bread, some of the best! The cheese sticks are ok, average but the dip is delicious and the pizza is sol good. I think my favourite in new york. Their reputation is well deserved.

sources.text: Best Pizza in Greenwich Village | John's of Bleecker St. Skip to main content Twitter / X page Facebook page Instagram page Yelp page Toggle navigation Menu Menu Drinks Order Shipping Nationwide on GoldBelly Hours Merch Twitter / X page Facebook page Instagram page Yelp page The decorative video is currently playing The decorative video sound is off Visit us at 278 Bleecker Street, New York, NY 10014 map marker pin A NYC establishment since 1929 Order online Order takeout or delivery Now shipping nationwide on Goldbelly Order Skip Photo Gallery About us History John's of Bleecker Street was founded by Italian immigrant Giovanni John Sasso at the turn of the 20th century. John's was originally established on Sullivan Street, in the heart of Greenwich Village. After losing his lease on Sullivan Street, John Sasso dismantled his original coal fired brick oven and moved to 278 Bleecker Street where he continued to run and grow his business and refine his pizza recipe to perfection. Read more about us slideshow start stop playing Slide 1 content Slide 2 content Slide 3 content Catering made easy Inquire Catering Our History Read more about us Shipping on Goldbelly Shipping Pies Reviews Start stop reviews carousel Review by - Yelp five star review by Rdg D: Pizza... this might be the bar by which all other NY pizza should be measured. Pasta... chick parm was the best we've had. Food as a whole were the best versions that we've ever had. It's hard to say what makes it perfect, but we can say that everything was done just right. Perfectly executed. Noisy, boisterous; think loud family dinner table! Wonderful place. Our favorite Italian restaurant. Review by - Yelp five star review by Gaby M: Absolutely delicious! Short wait for a large group outside. Really friendly staff, heaters in the outside tables. Would definitely recommend!! Review by - Yelp five star review by Matthew L: Came here around 5:30pm on a Sunday night and was seated right away. Overall, it was an amazing coal-fired pizza. The pizza had a perfect crisp without being overcooked and dry. The mozzarella was great, and the sauce was perfect. Definitely my favorite pizza in Manhattan. Review by - Yelp five star review by Prudence D: It's everything you want in a NY slice. Get whatever is hot and you will be very happy. I tried a cheese slice and the one with fresh mozz. Both were delicious, but the cheese slice had just come out of the oven and therefore was the clear winner. Be ready to order and have cash to keep the line moving. Take your slice outside and plan on eating standing up. Review by - Yelp five star review by Claudia L: Food: 10/10. We ordered half Margherita and half pepperoni. I'm not a pepperoni pizza fan and would always prefer Margherita but at John's, I preferred the pepperoni pizza. I feel like their pepperoni pizza tasted more of an A+ pepperoni than their margarita pizza tasting like a Margherita pizza. Service: amazing. Very warm and welcoming. review1: John's of Bleecker Street charms visitors with its history-lined walls and friendly staff, and the coal-oven pizza lives up to expectations for most diners.
review2: The coal-fired oven and the restaurant's long experience are credited for excellent pies, with diners recommending customizing the John's Original.
review3: Waits are the main watch-out, with diners queuing outside in all weather, and a few finding the pizza good rather than the best of the trip.
review4: Sides like garlic bread and the dipping sauce get strong praise, and many diners call John's their favorite pizza in the city.
